entities.name: PMID:25097016
observations: 2014 J Clin Virol primary study of 312 oral-cavity SCC patients assessed HPV16/18 E7 viral load and 5-year distant metastasis.
Abstract reports E7 load ≥15 copies/genome as independently associated with distant metastasis; no separate HPV16 versus HPV18 effect estimates reported.

entities.name: Oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma
observations: The directly relevant cohort included 312 oral-cavity SCC patients, distinguishing this evidence from oropharyngeal SCC.

entities.name: HPV E7 load and metastasis
observations: In 312 oral-cavity SCC patients, HPV16/18 E7 load ≥15 copies/genome was independently associated with 5-year distant metastasis; combined risk groups had 74% (high), 17% (intermediate), and 1% (low) rates.
The abstract does not provide separate HPV16/HPV18 effect estimates or identify a specific metastatic organ.
